Specification: This specification models the Dijkstra-Scholten tree algorithm for detecting termination of a diffusing distributed computation over an arbitrary directed network. Processes can be active or idle, send computation messages along graph edges, and send acknowledgment control messages in the reverse direction; the algorithm dynamically maintains an overlay tree of non-neutral processes rooted at the leader. The spec assumes asynchronous unordered delivery without message loss, and proves safety properties about counter consistency, overlay-tree structure, and correct termination detection, as well as a liveness property stating that once the computation has terminated, the leader eventually becomes neutral and thus detects termination.
AssumptionNames:
/\ \A e \in Edges :
             /\ (e \in Procs \X Procs)
             /\ (e[1] # e[2])
        /\ Leader \in Procs
        /\ InEdges(Leader) = {}
IfThenElse: IF neutral(p)' THEN [upEdge EXCEPT ![p] = NotAnEdge] ELSE upEdge
IF neutral(p) THEN [upEdge EXCEPT ![p] = e] ELSE upEdge
AlwaysOp: [] \A e \in Edges: sentUnacked[e] = rcvdUnacked[e] + acks[e] + msgs[e]

[](
          /\ O.edge # {} => G!IsTreeWithRoot(O, Leader)
          /\ N:: \A n \in O.node: ~neutral(n))
